graphql.denominator: Unique query-reachable Type.field declarations, including interface and concrete-type declarations separately. Raw totals retain the full pinned read schema. Scoped totals exclude only explicit owner-type or field names; shared and returned types are not transitively excluded. Argument identities are Type.field(argument) and inherit their owning field's scope. Fetched coordinates require actual query AST selections in sources reachable from exported functions; public coordinates additionally require a public typed projection. REST equivalents and selected-schema inclusion do not count as GraphQL fetching or public exposure.
graphql.exclusion_status: Explicit type and field exclusions apply only to scoped totals; raw totals retain the full read schema.

rest.denominator: Unique canonical named JSON-schema property declarations reachable from GET 2xx/3xx response schemas, per product. Shared declarations count once; recursive paths do not multiply keys. Dynamic map keys are unenumerated. Mapped properties require typed physical columns; path navigation alone is reported separately. Pagination total-count validation is control coverage, not a typed entity mapping. Public properties require a public route projection. Selected mappings and bindings require a source reachable from an exported function.

source_reachability.basis: Only sources reachable from exported function plans and their referenced scopes contribute to selected, mapped, fetched or bound coverage. The compiled source inventory is retained, including unreachable sources.

entity_limitations.check_runs: Suite association is exposed when known and supports retrieval. Analytical enrichment by suite is not approved; direct repository context preserves runs lacking suite metadata.
entity_limitations.release_assets: Release association is exposed when known and supports retrieval. Analytical enrichment by release/publisher is not approved; direct repository and uploader relationships preserve asset identity and actor roles.
entity_limitations.workflow_artifacts: Run and workflow retrieval routes are available. Analytical enrichment through the optional run relationship is not approved; direct repository enrichment preserves artifacts lacking run metadata.
entity_limitations.workflow_jobs: Attempt-specific retrieval is supported. Analytical joins use the run's latest state; enrichment by attempt attributes is not approved. Job-local run_attempt remains available for grouping.
entity_limitations.workflow_run_attempts: Requires an explicit run ID and attempt number; attempt history enumeration is not implemented.
